requirement.original: Investigate why sidechain forwarding changes are NOT working -- subagent internal operations do not appear in Agent tool sidebar
requirement.clarified: Claude Code writes subagent messages to separate files in a subagents/ subdirectory, not to the main session JSONL. The session scanner only reads the main JSONL, so it never finds sidechain messages to forward.
requirement.what: Fix session scanner to also read subagent JSONL files from the subagents/ subdirectory
requirement.why: Subagent internal operations (text, tool calls, thinking) are invisible in the browser because they never reach the happy-server

included: Reading subagent JSONL files from <sessionId>/subagents/ directory
Forwarding subagent messages with isSidechain: true to happy-server
Dedup between live stream and file scanner paths
excluded: Changes to the live SDK stream path (already works via sdkToLogConverter)

success_criteria: Subagent messages from files in subagents/ directory are forwarded to happy-server
No duplicate messages between live stream and file scanner
Resume with sendExisting includes subagent history
constraints: Cannot modify Claude Code's file writing behavior
Must not break existing session scanning for main JSONL
Must handle dynamic creation of new subagent files during a session

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Agent tool sidebar shows only prompt + tool calls + result, no subagent internal operations
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Session scanner reads only <projectDir>/<sessionId>.jsonl but Claude Code writes subagent messages to <projectDir>/<sessionId>/subagents/agent-<agentId>.jsonl. The main JSONL has ZERO isSidechain:true messages.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - architectural mismatch between scanner design and Claude Code's file structure
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The scanner was designed to read the main session JSONL, which was the only file format at the time. Claude Code later added subagent support with a separate file structure.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: The fix added isSidechain forwarding logic to the scanner, but the scanner never reads the files that contain isSidechain messages

context.codebase_state: Session scanner reads main JSONL only. sdkToLogConverter handles live stream sidechain via parent_tool_use_id.
context.recent_commits: Recent commits added isSidechain forwarding to sessionScanner.ts and dedup to claudeRemoteLauncher.ts

live_stream.has_isSidechain_in_sdk: NO - converter ADDS it based on parent_tool_use_id

development_approach.strategy: Modify sessionScanner to discover and scan subagent JSONL files in the <sessionId>/subagents/ directory. Watch the subagents directory for new files. Read each subagent JSONL and forward messages with isSidechain: true.
development_approach.validation_approach: 1. Check that subagent files are discovered and read. 2. Verify messages arrive at happy-server with isSidechain: true. 3. Check dedup between live stream and file paths. 4. Test resume with sendExisting.

research_findings.reason: Root cause investigation of existing code behavior, not a design pattern question
